reviews.text:
I highly recommend Dr. Minuto and Dr. Rita for their professionalism and kindness.
Truly super reliable.
Very kind person, he does his job with a lot of love.
Very neglected clinic, doctor's assistant quite exhausted 😢 good doctor without a doubt but I expected more …

Dr. Minuto is a true saint to our four-legged friends!

His skill, passion, and dedication make him an elite veterinarian, watching over animals like Saint Francis himself.

My faithful Rainbow always finds refuge in his safe and caring hands.

Thank you for everything you do... May God bless you...!!!
I have known Dr. Minuto for 9 years for my Marilyn. He is excellently professional, makes you feel at ease, and loves animals very much....great Minuto...

I took Milord for his annual booster shot. I can confirm my excellent experience with the doctor. My cat was very good, the doctor was attentive and ready to answer any questions I had. It's always a pleasure to chat with him 🙏🏻 Even though he's not very close to my house, I prefer him to many doctors. Thanks always for the excellent work!
Vincenzo is the best vet I've ever met. He's brilliant! He and his colleague Rita are brilliant!

Dr. Minuto, besides being a great professional, is definitely someone who loves his job and animals, not at all greedy. I want to emphasize the courtesy of both the doctor and his partner and, above all, the cleanliness of the premises. Practically everything I was looking for for my furry friend.

I have to give one star otherwise it won't let me write and save other animals, dirty and poorly maintained environment just like the same doctor who has no professional role, he claims to be open from 10:00 to 13:00, but with an emergency at 12:40 he slams the door in my face saying, or rather yelling, to come back at 17 because he is his woman they had to have lunch, for months given the same treatment every month to cure my ear infection which has been treated well for over a year, I tell you run away, there are others much better and more competent.
The doctor is really good and honest, he loves animals!

I went to Dr. Minuto some time ago, a delightful person, he examined my dog ​​and made a timely diagnosis which was subsequently verified. I regretfully had to resolve the problem in another city where I was temporarily transferred. Honor and thanks to the doctor and returned to Naples I can't wait to entrust my furry friend again.
I really appreciate this doctor, he is professional and above all he loves animals

I can't agree with her work because I've never been there. I live in Tuscany, but I'm sending this review only because she must be an excellent veterinarian and a true animal lover.
I completely agree with the letter she sent to the Pope. I have a grown son and three furry children whom I love immensely.
If we all had more respect for animals, perhaps there wouldn't be so much cruelty.
If I ever find myself in Naples, I'll definitely come and meet her. These are my loves.
